# Burnly v0.1.32

Fixes false-positive `antigravity.runtime_not_found` warnings and `source.not_found` refresh failures when local Antigravity CLI session databases exist with zero token generation records while the runtime is inactive.

## Highlights

- **Antigravity empty session tolerance.** Launching `agy` to browse models or inspect configurations without submitting prompts creates an empty conversation database on disk. Burnly now treats successfully parsed zero-token sessions as normal clean usage instead of assuming active turns are pending in an offline language-server runtime.
- **Offline SQLite conversation tracking.** The Antigravity collector tracks conversations verified through local SQLite storage, ensuring offline zero-token CLI sessions do not trigger unnecessary runtime discovery checks.
- **Accurate refresh status.** Manual and scheduled refreshes complete with status `succeeded` rather than `partial` when Antigravity has no activity for the requested date window.

## Privacy

Burnly continues to read usage-only metadata. It selects model identity, token
counters, and generation timestamps; it never reads prompt text, response
content, tool invocations, project paths, or sensitive credentials.

## Install

### Linux

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-linux.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.32/install-linux.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.32 sh
```

### Windows Preview

Download the Windows x64 installer from this release:

```text
burnly-v0.1.32-windows-x86_64.exe
```

The Windows preview installer is not Authenticode-signed. Windows may show an
unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning. Only download Burnly from the
official GitHub release and verify the published `SHA256SUMS`. Tauri updater
artifacts remain cryptographically signed.

### macOS Preview

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-macos.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.32/install-macos.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.32 sh
```

Manual `.dmg` installation is also available:

```text
burnly-v0.1.32-macos-aarch64.dmg
burnly-v0.1.32-macos-x86_64.dmg
```

The macOS preview is unsigned and not notarized. If Gatekeeper blocks the
downloaded app, clear quarantine once after copying it to Applications:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Burnly.app
```

## Verification

This release was verified with local unit tests across the Antigravity collector,
including offline empty database tests, runtime missing tests, and full test suite
execution (119 frontend tests, 716 Rust tests). Live desktop evidence verified that
manual refreshes on Linux with empty CLI databases complete cleanly with status `succeeded`.

Release artifacts include `SHA256SUMS`, GitHub build provenance, signed updater
artifacts, `latest.json`, and the `latest-linux.json` compatibility alias.
